featured_case_study.title: ShopSmart Brand Refresh & Web Platform
featured_case_study.challenge: Client had an outdated website that was slow on mobile and lacked a cohesive brand identity.
featured_case_study.solution: Priya designed a fresh brand style guide in Figma, sneha integrated it into React, and Amit completed site speed optimizations.
featured_case_study.result: Page speed score increased to 98/100, and user bounce rate decreased by 30%.
